title: Simulation 3D Tractor
text: Implement tractor in 3D environment, 2 inputs, {Color} sets Vehicle color; {Type} sets the tractor type Conventional, {Name}, {Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation} sets the vehicle initial translation zeros, {Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation} sets the vehicle initial rotation zeros and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type
params.values: Tractor type Conventional tractor (default) | Cab-over tractor

params.name: Color
params.values: Vehicle color Red (default) | Orange | Yellow | Green | Blue | Black | White | Silver | Dazzle camouflage

params.name: Name
params.values: Name of vehicle SimulinkVehicle1 (default) | character vector

params.name: Initial array values to translate vehicle per part, Translation
Initial array values to rotate vehicle per part, Rotation
